agent_role: Agent A - Component and Source Authority Auditor

components.name: HAI data provenance
components.research_role: Pins the approved HAI source, edition, file identities, structure, and public label-custody metadata.
components.input_summary: Pinned official HAI repository metadata and authorized public-safe file identities.
components.output_summary: Self-hashed provenance, structure, manifest, and label-custody public records.
components.next_action: Preserve the frozen provenance and rehearse restoration on a fresh machine without exposing private payloads.

components.name: Dataset split governance
components.research_role: Enforces dataset-neutral operation permissions, raw-timeline splitting, and purge-gap requirements.
components.input_summary: Frozen split roles, raw ranges, window specification, and operation request.
components.output_summary: Validated split collection and permitted windows with purge boundaries.
components.next_action: Deep-review all later experiment entry points against the same split-role contract.

components.name: P1 variable-role candidate universe
components.research_role: Freezes eligible sources, targets, and the bounded source-target comparison universe.
components.input_summary: Reviewed P1 variable metadata and frozen candidate policy.
components.output_summary: A 12-source by 12-target universe containing 144 possible directed pairs.
components.next_action: Confirm role semantics and exclusions during ARCH-000 without changing the frozen universe.

components.name: Metadata candidate discovery
components.research_role: Ranks candidate pairs from reviewed metadata and official graph references without feature values.
components.input_summary: Frozen 144-pair universe and reviewed public metadata evidence.
components.output_summary: Audited rankings including a complete top-20; metadata support is not causality.
components.next_action: Compare unique confirmed-relation contribution and stability against STAT and GDN.

components.name: Statistical candidate discovery
components.research_role: Ranks pairs using file-local normal-only lagged-change correlation evidence.
components.input_summary: Frozen 144-pair universe and authorized P1 train1/train2 normal values.
components.output_summary: Audited top-20 ranking with stability evidence; statistical association is not causality.
components.next_action: Measure seed/split stability and unique confirmed-relation contribution under a preregistered comparison.

components.name: Upstream-aligned GDN candidate discovery
components.research_role: Produces graph-ranking candidate evidence within the same frozen pair universe.
components.input_summary: Frozen 144-pair mask, normal train1/train2 segments, pinned upstream code, and exact dependency receipt.
components.output_summary: Audited upstream-aligned top-20 ranking from three seeds; graph edges remain candidate evidence, not causes.
components.next_action: Validate unique and stable contribution beyond META/STAT plus edge/source masking behavior.

components.name: Three-arm candidate union
components.research_role: Integrates META, STAT, and GDN rankings as an unscored provenance-preserving union.
components.input_summary: Frozen META, STAT, and GDN ranked candidate artifacts.
components.output_summary: A frozen union cohort of 47 unique candidate pairs with arm provenance.
components.next_action: Deep-review union provenance and arm-overlap semantics; do not treat union membership as validation.

components.name: Normal temporal relation profiling
components.research_role: Fits direction- and lag-aware delayed-response evidence using authorized normal files.
components.input_summary: The 47-pair candidate cohort and authorized normal training values.
components.output_summary: Audited fit artifacts leading to 23 pair contexts and 42 confirmed directed temporal relations.
components.next_action: Compare numeric criteria and stability without upgrading normal association to physical truth.

components.name: Normal-only numeric authority
components.research_role: Derives and binds rule timing, tolerance, persistence, and scale references from normal data only.
components.input_summary: COMMON-42 relation identities and authorized normal calibration inputs.
components.output_summary: Frozen private numeric registry plus sanitized authority and audit bindings.
components.next_action: Keep values private and perform formal comparative validation of rule numeric criteria.

components.name: Normal relation evidence pack
components.research_role: Carries normal-only relation support, stability, regime, and parameter-reference evidence into rule construction.
components.input_summary: Confirmed relation records, normal fit summaries, and numeric authority references.
components.output_summary: Typed construction evidence for the frozen relation cohort.
components.next_action: Review evidence completeness and claim boundaries at function level in ARCH work.

components.name: Canonical delayed-response Rule v1 DSL
components.research_role: Defines the bounded, typed, serializable rule contract used by construction, verification, and runtime.
components.input_summary: Bounded construction output and referenced normal-only parameters.
components.output_summary: Canonical immutable Rule v1 documents with provenance and operational semantics.
components.next_action: Verify all COMMON-42 documents remain within canonical Rule v1 and avoid Rule v2 scope drift.

components.name: T0 deterministic template construction
components.research_role: Provides the deterministic rule-construction comparator.
components.input_summary: Frozen evidence, parameter authority, candidate binding, and template policy.
components.output_summary: 42 of 42 accepted construction outcomes in the frozen cohort.
components.next_action: Use as a preregistered comparator in expanded construction-quality validation.

components.name: T1 one-shot constrained construction
components.research_role: Provides the bounded one-shot LLM construction comparator.
components.input_summary: Same frozen construction evidence and bounded provider policy as the comparison cohort.
components.output_summary: 42 of 42 accepted outcomes in the frozen pilot; provider reproduction remains incomplete.
components.next_action: Reproduce under a frozen provider policy before making comparative quality claims.

components.name: T1-B budget-matched repeated construction
components.research_role: Controls for total provider-call budget using independent generations without verifier feedback.
components.input_summary: Same frozen evidence with a three-generation budget-matched selection policy.
components.output_summary: 42 of 42 selected accepted outcomes after audited per-call parsing and selection.
components.next_action: Include in expanded comparison and preserve call-budget equivalence and selection semantics.

components.name: T2 verifier-feedback construction
components.research_role: Implements bounded revise, retrieve, and no-rule control using deterministic verifier feedback.
components.input_summary: Frozen evidence, bounded provider policy, verifier output, and retrieval policy.
components.output_summary: 39 accepted and 3 no-rule outcomes; feedback action rate was 0 and the feedback path was not empirically exercised.
components.next_action: Design a cohort that genuinely exercises feedback while preserving arm comparability; do not claim agentic advantage now.

components.name: Deterministic Rule v1 verifier
components.research_role: Checks structural, compatibility, evidence-binding, parameter, operational, and claim-boundary validity independently of labels.
components.input_summary: Canonical rule, relation/evidence bindings, parameter references, graph policy, and verifier policy.
components.output_summary: Deterministic staged verification result; it does not prove physical truth or causality.
components.next_action: Deep-review each verifier stage and keep scientific-validity claims outside its authority.

components.name: COMMON-42 frozen rule authority
components.research_role: Freezes the common verified 42-relation/rule portfolio used by downstream rule utility.
components.input_summary: Frozen confirmed-relation cohort, construction outcomes, verifier acceptance, and numeric references.
components.output_summary: A canonical public authority binding exactly 42 verified directed rules without private numeric values.
components.next_action: Preserve exact bytes and use as the sole rule portfolio authority for current pilot interpretation.

components.name: LLM-free fixed-rule runtime
components.research_role: Executes frozen verified relation rules against runtime windows with deterministic parameter resolution.
components.input_summary: Frozen rule envelope, validated numeric resolver, and canonical runtime window.
components.output_summary: Deterministic rule execution result with violation, satisfaction, or abstention semantics.
components.next_action: Confirm runtime determinism and authority closure in ARCH review; do not generalize LLM-free status to hypothetical future modes.

components.name: Runtime satisfaction trace
components.research_role: Records observed rule-evaluation steps and parameter bindings for deterministic traceability.
components.input_summary: Authorized fixed rule, runtime window, resolved parameters, and evaluated conditions.
components.output_summary: Canonical trace bound to runtime facts and outcome.
components.next_action: Audit trace-to-outcome completeness and explanation handoff in ARCH work.

components.name: Trace-grounded explanation renderer
components.research_role: Renders rule, trace, provenance, and observed outcome into bounded deterministic explanations.
components.input_summary: Frozen rule identity, runtime trace, parameter provenance, and observed outcome.
components.output_summary: Deterministic trace-grounded explanation record; human usefulness has not been evaluated.
components.next_action: Evaluate faithfulness systematically; consider human usefulness only as a separately scoped future study.

components.name: D0 PCA-SPE reference detector
components.research_role: Provides the frozen baseline detector for INNER pilot utility comparison.
components.input_summary: Frozen 37-feature P1 frame plus private preprocessing, PCA model, and threshold authorities.
components.output_summary: Frozen label-blind prediction and pilot metrics; it is a simple reference detector, not an optimal baseline claim.
components.next_action: Keep the frozen pilot intact and add a stronger multivariate baseline in a new preregistered evaluation.

components.name: D1 verified rule-only arm
components.research_role: Evaluates frozen COMMON-42 rules as a standalone anomaly signal.
components.input_summary: Frozen COMMON-42 rules, private numeric resolver, and INNER P1 features.
components.output_summary: Frozen label-blind rule prediction and 14-event pilot metrics; operational utility remains unvalidated because normal FAR is high.
components.next_action: Prioritize expanded Rule-only evaluation, false-alarm analysis, and generalization without changing the frozen pilot.

components.name: D2 V1 same-second fusion
components.research_role: Tests a preregistered same-second D0 plus multi-source D1 fusion policy.
components.input_summary: Exact frozen D0 and D1 prediction artifacts plus preregistered V1 fusion policy.
components.output_summary: Frozen pilot combined prediction and metrics; current policy recovered zero of three D0-missed events.
components.next_action: Treat as a negative pilot observation; do not tune or claim detector-plus-rule improvement from it.

components.name: D2 V2 native-horizon fusion
components.research_role: Tests a preregistered native-horizon rule-evidence fusion policy with frozen D0 and D1 artifacts.
components.input_summary: Exact frozen D0 and D1 prediction artifacts plus preregistered V2 native-horizon policy.
components.output_summary: Frozen pilot combined prediction and integrity completion; current policy recovered zero of three D0-missed events and increased FAR.
components.next_action: Treat as a negative pilot observation; do not create V3 from result-driven tuning inside RCC.

components.name: Alarm episode construction
components.research_role: Forms maximal contiguous one-second alarm episodes under the frozen file-local policy.
components.input_summary: Ordered alarm timestamps from a frozen prediction artifact.
components.output_summary: Canonical maximal contiguous half-open alarm intervals.
components.next_action: Preserve the episode policy across expanded evaluation and state any deviations before execution.

components.name: Attack-event Recall metric
components.research_role: Measures attack events overlapped by at least one alarm episode.
components.input_summary: Frozen alarm episodes and label-derived maximal attack events after prediction freeze.
components.output_summary: Bound Attack-event Recall receipts for the INNER pilot.
components.next_action: Retain as the primary event metric while expanding beyond the current 14-event pilot.

components.name: Normal FAR episodes per hour
components.research_role: Measures alarm episodes with no attack overlap per hour of labeled normal exposure.
components.input_summary: Frozen alarm episodes, attack events, and private normal labeled exposure.
components.output_summary: Bound Normal FAR episodes/hour receipts without exposing private denominators.
components.next_action: Preserve episode numerator semantics and treat the high D1 FAR as a primary operational risk.

components.name: Frozen result integrity auditing
components.research_role: Independently verifies authority replay, immutable predictions, metric arithmetic, access ordering, and leakage controls.
components.input_summary: Frozen public artifacts, committed source bytes, and separately authorized private oracle inputs.
components.output_summary: Sanitized independent integrity reports for D0, D1, D2 V1, and D2 V2.
components.next_action: Consolidate audit coverage and distinguish integrity verification from external reproduction.

components.name: Held-out OUTER evaluation
components.research_role: Would assess held-out generalization under preregistered one-way evaluation governance.
components.input_summary: Preregistered three-arm authority plus unresolved private-custody prerequisites.
components.output_summary: A sanitized blocker and custody/accounting record; no OUTER prediction or scientific metric exists.
components.next_action: Require separate approval, fresh preregistration, and reproducible custody before any held-out execution.

components.name: Scientific reproducibility and preservation
components.research_role: Tracks authority pins, artifact preservation, environment and private-custody requirements, and restoration readiness.
components.input_summary: Pinned Git history, frozen artifacts, environment receipts, and public-safe preservation evidence.
components.output_summary: Strong traceability and moderate same-machine reproducibility, but weak/incomplete fresh-machine portability.
components.next_action: Run a separately authorized fresh-machine reproduction rehearsal with private-custody prerequisites documented.

components.name: Professor-facing first-results reporting
components.research_role: Synthesizes the implemented architecture, frozen pilot observations, limitations, and next research questions for review.
components.input_summary: Frozen public pilot artifacts, implementation inventory, and audited claim boundaries.
components.output_summary: Public-safe first-results report that explicitly avoids statistical superiority and held-out claims.
components.next_action: Keep professor-facing wording synchronized with RCC claim boundaries and record later changes explicitly.

components.name: Provisional thesis working draft
components.research_role: Provides narrative structure and provisional thesis framing without overriding scientific artifacts.
components.input_summary: Documentation-overlay narrative context and public-safe scientific references.
components.output_summary: A provisional working draft that is not a scientific authority and requires claim-boundary review.
components.next_action: Review all result wording against the scientific checkpoint before promoting thesis prose.

uncertainties.assessment: The frozen schema has one boolean but no claim-scope field. This staging file marks true only where a narrow implementation or integrity claim is supportable; it does not mean scientific effectiveness or generalization is ready.

Independent audits and deterministic replays exist, but the checkpoint explicitly describes fresh-machine portability as incomplete. All components therefore remain reproduced=false in this conservative population.

OUTER custody and accounting controls were audited, but no scientific prediction/result exists. The component is BLOCKED and audited=false to avoid presenting control-path audit as scientific-result audit.

mismatches.description: RCC-000 correctly called T1/T1-B/T2 research-only implementations but encoded their lifecycle status as RESEARCH_ONLY, which hides that their frozen pilot paths were actually executed and audited.
mismatches.resolution_recommendation: Use IMPLEMENTED_EXECUTED_AUDITED for lifecycle, retain research-only as scope wording, and keep claim_ready=false.

mismatches.description: A file or recovery controller exists for OUTER, but the authoritative reporting states that no held-out scientific result exists.
mismatches.resolution_recommendation: Keep OUTER status BLOCKED and never label the blocker as failed detector performance.

mismatches.description: GDN has an upstream-aligned executed and audited ranking, but this does not establish unique useful contribution beyond META/STAT and does not support causal or root-cause wording.
mismatches.resolution_recommendation: Keep lifecycle audited while claim_ready=false and require a preregistered contribution/stability comparison.

mismatches.description: T2 was executed, but its feedback activation rate was zero and its feedback path was not empirically exercised in the current cohort.
mismatches.resolution_recommendation: Do not use agentic-advantage wording for current results.

mismatches.description: Runtime fixed-rule execution is LLM-free for the frozen current path; this must not be generalized to every possible future runtime comparison mode.
mismatches.resolution_recommendation: Qualify the claim by frozen rule/reference/input and current runtime version.

mismatches.description: Explanation rendering and satisfaction traces exist, but no human usefulness evaluation exists.
mismatches.resolution_recommendation: Separate automated trace faithfulness from human comprehension or operational-usefulness claims.

coordinator_notes: All component implementation and result statements are grounded in the scientific authority commit except THESIS_DRAFT, which is explicitly bound to the read-only documentation overlay.
The 29 executed components include supporting infrastructure exercised in frozen pipelines, not 29 independently validated scientific contributions.
Do not infer scientific superiority, causal validity, operational usefulness, held-out generalization, or fresh-machine reproduction from lifecycle status.
Artifact IDs are recommended merge keys for Agent C/coordinator reconciliation; repository-relative evidence paths are the primary source citations.
